diagnosis: The GetDocumentTemplate function uses GORM Where('id = ?', docID).First(&tmpl) without enforcing organization_id constraints. Any authenticated organization user can access proprietary legal contracts, mutual non-disclosure agreements, and clauses belonging to other organizations.
